description: The oval is the round brilliant stretched — the same facet count and fire, carried along a longer path so colour and brilliance arrive together rather than alternating. Set stone after stone in a bracelet, the ovals do not sit passively side by side; each is forward-set so it presents its full face in rotation as the wrist moves, catching light at its own moment. The result is a line that never reads as static — a continuous turn of brilliance around the wrist. Made in eighteen-karat gold.
